Era-adjusted stats

Source: R/era.R
nhl_era_adjust.Rd

Rescales each season to one scoring environment, by default the average of the last ten completed seasons over an 82-game schedule, so a 1952 season and a 2022 one read on the same scale:

Usage

nhl_era_adjust(stats, baseline = NULL, env = nhl_league_env())

Arguments

stats

Player seasons: goals and assists for skaters, goals_against_average (or goals_against_avg) and save_pct (or save_pctg) for goalies.

baseline

The seasons, as start years, whose average is the standard; the default is the last ten in nhl_league_env().

env

The environment table; nhl_league_env() by default.

Value

stats with adj_goals, adj_assists and adj_points (skater columns present) and adj_gaa and save_pct_vs_league (goalie columns present).

Details

  • goals by the league's goals a game, assists by its assists a game, both by the schedule (to 82 games) and by roster size (skaters dressed a game: a 1920s star shared the scoring with nine or ten teammates, not seventeen), as Hockey-Reference adjusts;

  • a goalie's goals-against average by the league's goals a game, and his save percentage against the league's that season.

Works on any table of player seasons with a season column (season_id from nhl_stats(), season from nhl_player()'s season_totals). Only NHL regular seasons are adjusted; other leagues, the playoffs and any season nhl_league_env() does not cover (the one in progress) get NA.

Examples

gretzky <- data.frame(season_id = c(19811982, 19851986), goals = c(92, 52), assists = c(120, 163))
nhl_era_adjust(gretzky)
#>   season_id goals assists adj_goals adj_assists adj_points
#> 1  19811982    92     120   66.2495    88.28109   154.5306
#> 2  19851986    52     163   40.0524   128.55935   168.6118
